statement: Device facts copied from manufacturer documents and from records the manufacturer submitted to the FDA device database, each with the document and place it was read. Nothing here has been fact-checked by the manufacturer: every fact check reads NOT REVIEWED. A dimensional comparison is not a statement of compatibility. Values that were measured from images or chosen by the author are marked as such and are not device facts.
